stem: Phenylamine, $\text{C}_6\text{H}_5\text{NH}_2$, and ethylamine, $\text{C}_2\text{H}_5\text{NH}_2$, can be distinguished by adding aqueous bromine.

parts.label: (a)
parts.text: State what is seen when aqueous bromine is added to phenylamine.

parts.label: (b)
parts.text: Suggest what is seen when aqueous bromine is added to ethylamine.

parts.label: (c)
parts.text: Draw the structure of the organic product formed when an excess of aqueous bromine is added to phenylamine.

parts.label: (d)
parts.text: Name the product you have drawn in (c).
